title: Prior Authorization Extension Allowances by Class
content:
**Provider Manual table.** For each Prior Authorization class, Prairie Ridge Health Plan sets whether an approval may be extended, the most extensions granted on one authorization, the most units one extension may add (the class's extension allotment), the calendar days one extension adds to the end date, the calendar days after the end date during which an extension request is still accepted as an extension rather than a new request, and the calendar days between concurrent reviews during an approval.

| Class | Extension allowed | Most extensions per authorization | Most units one extension may add | Days one extension adds to the end date | Late grace after the end date (calendar days) | Concurrent review interval (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Advanced Imaging Authorization | No | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 (not applicable) |
| Outpatient Rehabilitation Therapy Authorization | Yes | 2 | 12 | 60 | 3 | 0 (not applicable) |
| Durable Medical Equipment Authorization | Yes | 1 | 13 | 180 | 0 | 0 (not applicable) |
| Home Health Services Authorization | Yes | 3 | 30 | 60 | 3 | 30 |
| Behavioral Health Intensive Services Authorization | Yes | 4 | 15 | 14 | 1 | 7 |
| Elective Inpatient and Surgical Authorization | Yes | 3 | 5 | 7 | 0 | 3 |
| Out-of-Network Services Authorization | Yes | 1 | 6 | 60 | 0 | 0 (not applicable) |

A late grace of 0 means an extension request must be received no later than the end date itself to be accepted as an extension.

**Reading a row (hypothetical).** For a hypothetical Behavioral Health Intensive Services Authorization approval, up to 4 extensions may be granted, each adding no more than 15 program days and moving the end date 14 calendar days forward; an extension request received on the first calendar day after the end date is still accepted as an extension, one received on the second day is not.
